entries.reason: Laying out one world tries at most 100,000 placements: a placement is one footprint tried against what is placed, or one point a search for free ground lists. Measured 2026-10-06 on the development machine: the hand-written test kinds try at most 304 in a world, a holding scattered over a 256 m site 443, and small fixtures searching for room round larger ones 623,633, which took 0.37 s; a layout reaching 100,000 was refused in 0.05 s. A layout past it is refused by name before it does the work.
